title: 第一卷第9章 魂魄有缺不治之症第一卷第10章 我有个朋友
content_zh:
看着不远处的李总管。
顾寒一颗心瞬间提了起来，下意识握紧了手中长剑。
强！
很强！
这个自称咱家，语气阴柔的老者，给了他一种极其危险，根本无法抵抗的感觉！
轻轻挪动一步。
他将背后的洞口瞬间堵住。
那里。
阿傻依旧在沉睡。
自那天和顾统领一战，已是过去了两天的时间，可阿傻却是一反常态，一直睡到了现在，顾寒以为是她太过疲累的缘故，索性在此地开凿出一个山洞，让她好好休息休息。
有红色小蛇的气息残留。
这里少有人和妖兽敢接近，短时间内，也算是个安全的地方。
至于那颗果子。
自然早已被他摘下吃掉。
只不过。
虽然这颗果子神异，帮他顺利突破了凝气期，可也仅仅迈入了开脉二重境而已，却是远逊于那条红色小蛇的毒液了。
思来想去没个头绪。
他也只能将原因归结在体内的液态灵力和那远宽于常人的经脉了。
“小子！”
见顾寒不说话，李总管有些不耐烦。

“咱家问你话呢，那颗烈阳果，哪去了！”
烈阳果？
是那颗果子的名字？
“我不知道。”
顾寒自然不会承认。
“我没见过你说的什么烈阳果。”
“奸滑的小子！”
李总管眉毛一挑。
“你敢骗咱家？没见过，你身上烈阳果的气息哪来的！还不快跟咱家从实招来！”
“……”
顾寒无语。
content_en:
Looking at Manager Li not far away.
Gu Han's heart suddenly rose, and he subconsciously clenched the sword in his hand.
powerful!
Very strong!
This old man who called himself our family and had a gentle tone gave him an extremely dangerous feeling that he couldn't resist at all!
Move slightly.
He blocked the hole behind his back instantly.
There.
Asha was still sleeping.
Two days had passed since the battle with Commander Gu that day, but Ah Sha was uncharacteristically sleeping until now. Gu Han thought it was because she was too tired, so he simply dug a cave here to let her have a good rest.
There is the scent of a red snake remaining.
Few people and monsters dare to approach here, and it can be considered a safe place for a short period of time.
As for the fruit.
Of course he had already picked it off and eaten it.
only.
Although this fruit was magical and helped him successfully break through the Qi Condensation stage, it had only entered the second stage of opening pulses, but it was far inferior to the venom of the little red snake.
After thinking about it, I have no idea.
He could only attribute the reason to the liquid spiritual power in his body and the meridians that were much wider than ordinary people.
"Boy!"
Seeing that Gu Han didn't speak, Manager Li was a little impatient.
"I'm asking you a question, where did that Sun Fruit go?"
Sun fruit?
Is that the name of that fruit?
"I don't know."
Gu Han would naturally not admit it.
"I have never seen the Sun Fruit you mentioned."
"Cunning boy!"
Manager Li raised his eyebrows.
"How dare you lie to our family? I've never seen it before, where does the aura of the Sun Fruit on your body come from! Why don't you come and recruit us for real!"
"..."
Gu Han was speechless.
